messages:
elaine.p: Heads-up: next Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC we're doing a Service Account Consolidation + Actions permission enforcement. Goal: remove dozens of repo-level SA/PATs and replace them with scoped org service principals and ephemeral CI tokens. Runbook: https://go.internal/sa-consolidation (required reading)

mira.s: Summary of user-facing changes? will workflows break if owners don’t act?

elaine.p: TL;DR:
- Repo-level service accounts and user-scoped PATs will be deprecated. They will stop working during the enforcement window.
- New model: org-scoped service principals (name format: svc-ci-<team>) + per-workflow scope tokens issued by the Token Broker.
- Runners & bots will use short-lived tokens (TTL 15m) fetched via the agent. Upgrade runner-agent >=0.12.0.
- Automated migration tool `sa-migrate` can map old SA -> new principal in dry-run mode. Example: `sa-migrate --org redwood --dry-run --output migration-plan.json`

jose.infra: Self-hosted runner note: runner-agent will call `/token-exchange` on the broker. You must remove embedded PATs from /etc/runner/creds and install agent v0.12.0. There is a cleanup helper: `scripts/cleanup-pats.sh` in infra repo.

ana.devex: I'll publish a PR template and a short checklist for repo-owners. Can we get a staging org to validate the flow?

elaine.p: Staging org: `redwood-sa-staging`. Use `./run-preflight.sh --org redwood-sa-staging --sa-migration` and paste results here. Look for `exchange: ok` and `workflow-run: success` lines.

sec-ops: Security notes:
- Policy enforcement date will be announced in the runbook; after that org policy will block secrets that match PAT patterns in repo secrets.
- We will run an audit scan 24h pre-enforcement and revoke any tokens flagged as user-scoped. Please rotate flagged tokens.
- New principals are bound to least-privilege roles; review the mapping table in the doc.

mira.s: How does this interact with GitHub Apps/Installations and Deploy keys?

elaine.p: GitHub Apps remain supported. Deploy keys are allowed but we will recommend moving to org apps where possible. The migration tool can convert deploy keys to app installations for repos that opt-in.

ci-bot: Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% across repos. Gates: workflow_success_rate >= 99.5%, token_exchange_p95 < 400ms. Canary start: -00:30 UTC. Automated rollback: re-enable legacy auth passthrough for 30m.

jose.infra: Monitoring to watch: grafana panel "SA Migration" metrics: `token.exchange.errors`, `runner.register.latency`, `actions.workflow.fail_rate`. Alerts: P1 pager, P2 slack.

ana.devex: Office hours planned Fri 16:00 UTC in #eng-platform and a short walkthrough demo Thu 11:00 UTC. I'll post the PR checklist and a sample migration PR that converts a repo token to the new principal.

sec-ops: Post-migration audit: we'll run `go/internal/secrets-audit --org redwood --only-pat` and schedule a forced rotation for any remaining user-scoped tokens. We will also publish a CSV of migrated principals for compliance teams.

mira.s: Action items recap:
- Dev teams: run preflight by Thu EOD and remove hardcoded PATs
- Runner owners: upgrade agent to v0.12.0 and remove stored creds
- Repo admins: review migration-plan.json and accept new principal invites
- Security: run audit and coordinate rotations

elaine.p: Thanks — file migration PRs and paste preflight output here. If you hit blockers during the window ping @jose.infra or @sec-ops. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Pager schedule: infra-oncall will be paged for P1 alerts during the window. Ensure on-call coverage.
